about: The one table of act words (acts.py). Each key is an act a card can offer: act.<type> or act.<type>.<when-value>, read from types.json. label is the plainest word for the act; meaning is one line, second person, saying its consequence; role_word is whose act it is. kinds gives other words where the same act means another thing on another kind of item; a kind's `as` gives other words again where the act means another thing for the side that takes it (the transition's `who`). role.<name> keys say a reader's role in plain words. The HUD's strings.json mirrors these under the same keys. Data, never instructions.

act.say.label: Say something
act.say.meaning: You add a line on it. It changes nothing, and everyone on it can read it.

act.say.ask.label: Ask a question
act.say.ask.meaning: You ask a question on it. Nothing changes until someone answers.

act.settle.label: Close the conversation, keeping what it says
act.settle.meaning: You close this conversation (a thread). What it says now is kept as agreed.

act.claim.label: Take this card
act.claim.meaning: You take the card, a piece of work. It is yours to do until you finish it or let it go.

sighting.label: Take it on
sighting.meaning: You take on what someone saw (a sighting). You hold it now, and it may become a card.

act.release.label: Let it go
act.release.meaning: You let the card go. It is free for someone else to take.

commitment.label: Release them from it
commitment.meaning: You free them of this commitment. It ends, and no one owes it.

committor.label: Hand it back, with why
committor.meaning: You hand the commitment back undone, and you must give one line on why. They know where they stand, and may ask again.

committor_unbegun.label: Withdraw it, with why
committor_unbegun.meaning: You take back a commitment you have not begun, and you must give one line on why. It ends before the work starts, and they know where they stand.

act.hand.label: Hand it on
act.hand.meaning: You pass the card to someone else. They hold it now.

act.request.label: Ask someone to do it
act.request.meaning: You ask someone to hold the card. It waits on their answer.

act.offer.label: Offer to do it
act.offer.meaning: You offer to hold the card. It waits on their answer.

act.answer.accept.label: Say yes
act.answer.accept.meaning: You say yes to what was asked. The card becomes yours to do.

act.answer.decline.label: Decline
act.answer.decline.meaning: You say no, with thanks. The ask ends, and they know where they stand.

commitment.label: Decline it
commitment.meaning: You turn down this commitment to you. It ends before it starts.

act.done.label: Mark it done
act.done.meaning: You say the work is finished. The card closes as done.

sighting.label: Say it is fixed
sighting.meaning: You say what someone saw is no longer so. It closes as fixed.

act.kept.label: Say you did it
act.kept.meaning: You say you did what you committed to. It waits on the word of the one it was committed to that it was kept.

act.witness.label: Confirm it was kept
act.witness.meaning: You confirm they did what they committed to. The commitment closes as kept.

tea.label: Confirm the hours
tea.meaning: You confirm the time they gave is as it is written.

handoff.label: I have read it
handoff.meaning: You say you have read what the body handed back. Its card leaves your Deal.
handoff.role_word: the person the body answers for

act.learn.label: Write what you learned
act.learn.meaning: You add what you learned to it, for whoever does this next.

act.decide.label: Decide it
act.decide.meaning: You make the decision. The proposal (what was put forward) becomes a decision the group can act on.

act.ratify.label: Back the decision
act.ratify.meaning: You back what was decided. It binds the group, and its work can begin.

act.revoke.label: Stop letting your agent act
act.revoke.meaning: You end what you let your agent do. It stops acting for you there.

act.flame.label: Pass the Flame
act.flame.meaning: You hand on what you carry here to the next player.

act.discern.label: Rate your agent's draft
act.discern.meaning: You say whether your agent's draft was right: chosen, corrected or rated.

act.miss.label: Explain the missed date
act.miss.meaning: You give the reason it was not kept by its date, so it can be learned from.

act.clear.label: Say the blocker is gone
act.clear.meaning: You say what blocked the work is gone. The work it held up can go ahead.

act.agree.label: Agree the terms for your group
act.agree.meaning: You agree for your group. The terms between your group and theirs now stand.

act.concord.label: Agree these two words mean the same
act.concord.meaning: You agree the two words are linked as proposed. Each side keeps its own words.

act.wallet.accept.label: Accept the trade
act.wallet.accept.meaning: You accept what is offered. Nothing counts as value until it is complete.

act.wallet.settle.label: Mark the exchange complete
act.wallet.settle.meaning: You say the exchange is done on both sides. It closes as complete.

act.wallet.witness.label: Say you saw this
act.wallet.witness.meaning: You say you saw this exchange take place.

act.wallet.gift.label: Make it a gift, nothing owed
act.wallet.gift.meaning: You turn the offer into a gift. It is given, with nothing owed back.

act.stop.true.label: Lift the stop
act.stop.true.meaning: You let your agent act again where it was stopped.

act.receive.label: Say you have it
act.receive.meaning: You say it reached you. The sender sees it arrived.

act.elevate.label: Pass it on
act.elevate.meaning: You pass it to the wider circle around your group. They see it there, and it stays here too.

role.committor.label: the one who committed
role.committor.meaning: You made this commitment: you are its committor.

role.committee.label: the one it was committed to
role.committee.meaning: This commitment was made to you: you are its committee.

role.witness.label: its witness
role.witness.meaning: You are named to confirm it was kept.

role.holder.label: the one who holds it
role.holder.meaning: It is in your hands now.

role.keeper.label: the keeper of its group
role.keeper.meaning: You keep the group it lives in.

role.raiser.label: the one who raised it
role.raiser.meaning: You saw it or raised it.

role.member.label: a member of its group
role.member.meaning: You belong to the group it lives in.

role.reader.label: a reader
role.reader.meaning: You can read it and say something on it.
